name: B10-0160/2026 (ESN) – The arbitrary detention of President Mohamed Bazoum by the junta in Niger
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of President Mohamed Bazoum by the junta in Niger
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the July 2023 military coup in Niger and calls for the immediate release of the elected president, Mohamed Bazoum, his wife and his son, who have been held since then. It says their detention is arbitrary, as two international bodies have found. It also asks the European Union to talk with Niger's military rulers about migration, security and fighting terrorism, without punishing ordinary people for their leaders' decisions.

- The text is an opinion; nothing changes in law. It calls for Bazoum's release.
- It affects Niger's military rulers, Bazoum and his family, and the European Union's dealings with Niger.
- Next, the Parliament sends its position to European Union bodies, member states and Niger's military authorities.
